Class SocketServer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.network.socket.server.SocketServer
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServer, Remote
public class SocketServer extends Object implements VirtualServer
The SocketServer class represents a server that listens for client connections, manages them, and delegates their requests to the ControllerManager for processing. It implements the VirtualServer interface.
